name: observe-landing-with-snapshot
reason: Thread the queued-mode read into the real forge adapter.

name: observe-landing-in-status-only-queued-mode
reason: A short status-only read can also report an actual queue entry.

name: observe-real-queue-in-poll
reason: A queued-stack poll observes, but never requests, enqueue or merge.

name: retain-single-merge-destination
reason: Preserve the actual base from the forge in every merged result.

name: use-merge-facts-for-single-result
reason: A single already merged PR still has a destination.

name: use-merge-facts-for-queue-completion
reason: Do not turn a merge into a parent branch into a claim that trunk contains it.

name: publish-merge-fact-before-later-queries
reason: Keep observed effects even if the next PR read fails before a complete sweep.

name: describe-unmerged-frontier
reason: Report whether the frontier is actually queued, auto-merge enabled, or neither.
replace: | { readonly kind: "awaiting-merge"; readonly unmergedCount: number; readonly landing: T.MergeDisposition | undefined };

name: do-not-infer-queue-enrollment
reason: A clean or in-progress PR can be unqueued; refresh a wait when its observed landing state changes.
